info.title: Renuka Tracker API
info.description: Phase 2 identity, sessions and service health. Web login is for ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN. Native mobile login is for EMPLOYEE. Phase 3 includes department-scoped employee management, onboarding and password reset. Phase 4 adds attendance, timestamps, GPS checks, reports and exports. Phases 5–7 cover private GPS selfie evidence, field-visit review and scoped analytics.
